rule.plain_english: Commitments to the same vendor totaling above $50,000 within 24 hours require a valid director approval for that order, issued before it and used once. Missing evidence means refuse.
assumptions: 24 hours is the aggregation window chosen by the business owner
missing_evidence: the agent's prompt or policy text at the time of the incident
